about: Movie and series servers, in the order the web app offers them, chosen on 2026-10-25 by measuring from Kenya the picture actually decoded, the stream bitrate and the sound, on Matlock (2024) S1E1 and Dune: Part Two. Of the providers still alive that week only VixSrc was new and good enough; VidFast, VidSrc.cc, 111Movies, EmbedWave, Videasy (top level) and Mapple did not play or asked viewers to prove they are human, and VidSrc.su was 720p with a TV channel logo. In the Android app, where Sahrae plays the stream in its own player without the provider page, the order is by bitrate instead (cleanFirst in services/cleanStream.ts).

servers.name: VixSrc · 1080p · subtitles
servers.note: Matlock S1E1 and Dune: Part Two: renditions 1080p at 4.5 Mb/s, 720p at 2.1, 480p at 1.2 (H.264, AAC); English and Italian audio, 4 subtitle tracks on Dune. Starts by itself, no pop-up seen. Its web player starts at 720p and climbs; in Sahrae's player it opens at 1080p. Audio channels not measured (encrypted segments).

servers.name: VidRock · 1080p · sharpest
servers.note: Matlock S1E1: renditions 1080p at 5.0 Mb/s, 720p at 3.0, 360p at 0.8; showing 1080p after 34 s, the clearest picture measured. Dolby Digital Plus 5.1 on Dune: Part Two. Slow to start (up to ~20 s), and it was down (504 on vidrock.to and vidrock.net) at 20:05 on 2026-10-25, an hour after playing: the failover covers it. Refuses the web sandbox.

servers.name: VidZee · 1080p · 5.1
servers.note: Matlock S1E1 at 1920x1080, about 3 Mb/s H.264, one rendition (never drops), 5.1 AAC. The only server that plays inside the web Ad Shield sandbox.
